描述_EN: this figure is one of a number made under imperial command in the early 15th century and given as diplomatic gifts to leading tibetan religious figures. during the reigns of yongle and xuande a number of tibetan hierarchs were invited to the chinese court to conduct religious ceremonies or to create diplomatic links and on these occasions presents of images or ritual objects would be given.
描述_ZN: 此图是15世纪初在皇室命令下制作的，作为外交礼物送给西藏主要宗教人士的其中之一。 在永乐和宣德年间，一些西藏的统治者被邀请到中国宫廷举行宗教仪式或建立外交联系，在这些场合，他们会被赠送图像或仪式物品。
